issues.description: The Stock class method used to append a StockIngredient to the internal array is named addItem(...) in the template but is named addToStockIngredients(...) in both the problem statement UML and the solution. This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual operation (adding a StockIngredient to the stock inventory) can confuse students when mapping the UML and problem requirements to the provided template code and the expected solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template method addItem(StockIngredient) to addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) (or vice versa update the UML/problem text) so that the template, problem statement, and solution use the same method name for adding a StockIngredient to the stock.
